page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server utilizing the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include a 64-bit Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with 12 physical cores and 24 dedicated vCPUs. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity stands at 93.0 GB, which calculates to 3.88 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a dedicated NVIDIA T4 GPU from the Turing architecture with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network throughput, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and does not bundle local disk storage.

Benchmark results highlight an emphasis on GPU-assisted workloads over single-core host CPU speed. Single-core performance is constrained, recording 935.0 on Geekbench and 1107.39 on stress-ng, placing both metrics in the lower quartiles. Multi-core compute performance balances out to median levels across the PassMark CPU test (18301.8) and Geekbench multi-core test (7397.0). In contrast, deep learning prompt processing displays top-tier throughput via the NVIDIA T4 accelerator, achieving 8377.38 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model and 1130.26 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model. Output generation reaches 33.05 tokens per second on a 7B model.

The physical configuration presents clear tradeoffs between CPU processing limits and specialized GPU capacity. Because local storage is absent, persistent application data requires network-attached storage volumes, which rely on the 8 Gbps network interface. The instance delivers cost-effective density for organizations running parallel inference tasks rather than high-clock single-thread applications. Workloads suited for this server include mid-scale large language model inference within the 16 GB VRAM ceiling, batch image processing, ray tracing, and deep learning model serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 24 vCPUs (12 physical cores) and 93.0 GB of memory. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of Turing-based VRAM. The instance features an 8 Gbps baseline network throughput and contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. In synthetic benchmarks, single-threaded CPU metrics place in lower tiers, while multi-core execution and memory operations deliver median-range throughput. GPU performance is particularly robust for lightweight deep learning inference, delivering top-tier prompt processing throughput for 135M and 7B parameter models. This configuration is structurally balanced for mid-scale AI model inference, computer vision, video transcoding, and GPU-assisted analytical pipelines where the 16 GB VRAM envelope is adequate.
